profile.headline: Software Engineer @Yardi | MS CS @ Georgia Tech

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Santa Barbara, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Built and scaled Yardi Case Manager, a ticketing platform within the Yardi Elevate suite, from beta through general availability, growing adoption to 70+ clients and contributing to eight-figure revenue growth, while partnering with cross-functional teams to integrate it across Yardi's core products.

• Owned end-to-end delivery of nearly a third of all post-beta feature requests, independently scoping and shipping capabilities that directly enabled Sales and Marketing to close new enterprise accounts.

• Owned weekly release cycles across production environments serving 1M+ end-users, holding the line on system performance and client satisfaction at scale.

• Diagnosed systemic performance bottlenecks and engineered optimizations that cut recurring production on-call tickets by 40% monthly, materially improving platform stability

• Currently building on Compliance Manager, a modernized interface unifying multiple Yardi platforms across social housing, PHA, and affordable housing verticals, including early AI automation initiatives

Technologies: C#, Angular, TypeScript, SQL Server, Git
https://www.yardi.com/product/case-manager/

positions.title: Research Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Developed an application that leveraged NLP voice assistant technology to create a
virtual human assistant. Worked within the Mixed Reality Lab (MxR) which focuses on
prototyping and experimentation for virtual, alternate and mixed reality. Funded by a
National Science Foundation grant via a competitive application process (awarded to
fewer than 9% of applicants).
Technologies: C# scripting, Blender, Unity 3D, Virtual Reality Wearables, API Cloud Services (Watson SDK)

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Conducted research using sound analysis software and tools to study the effects of noise pollution on bird ecosystems.
Utilized 3 years of research data and statistical methods to find correlation values of up to 0.9.
Technologies: Raven, Sound detecting hardware

Leveraged Agile Development, conducted user and client interviews.
Developed documentation for business owners to train future employees.

Code as a Second Language
Computer Science Instructor - Code as a Second Language, Atlanta, GA 
Taught students Minecraft modding through Microsoft MakeCode platform.
• Led CS classes on Scratch, HTML & CSS, game mods, and in browser virtual reality programming, allowing students to build simple games.
